project.name: hypermnesia-mcp
project.description: Cortex is a local-first persistent memory MCP server for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop), implementing a scientifically-grounded memory system based on computational neuroscience research, backed by SQLite or PostgreSQL + pgvector. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
